verdict.rationale: Vapi documents ways to test before production: Evals run mock conversations with automated validation "before production", Voice Test Suites simulate phone calls, and the CLI can forward webhooks to localhost and "switch between organizations and environments." However, nothing documents a dedicated sandbox environment with data isolated from production; the environment-switching claim is a single line with no detail. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented sandbox/test mode with isolated data, details on how CLI environments separate test from production resources, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
